senses.en_definition: A group of people, animals, or things gathered together.
A group or association of people or organizations sharing characteristics, tasks, or interests.
A collection of poems, stories, or other works.
An accumulated amount, especially a sum of money pooled into a fund.
(Chemistry) A vertical column of elements in the periodic table whose members have similar chemical properties.

messages.en: We're in the same group, right? I didn't see your name on the list earlier.
Yeah, the teacher's just added my name. I'll send you the notes later.
Okay, I'll get started on the slides. Just message me if you have any ideas.

senses.en_definition: A key inserted into a lock and turned to lock or unlock it.
A lock fitted to a door or other object and opened with a key.
Something essential to achieving a goal or solving a problem.
A set of correct answers to questions in an exercise or test.
(Music) A system of related notes or chords based on a particular keynote.
To secure a door or other object with a lock, bolt, or latch.

messages.en: The car key's on the table, okay? Don't forget to lock the door when you go out later.
I've got the key. I'll lock the door before I head out.

senses.en_definition: Insufficient in quantity or degree; below the required amount or standard.
Less or lower in amount or degree than something else.
Not very; not particularly, sometimes used to soften a statement.
Imperfect or deficient; having faults or shortcomings.
(Indonesian usage) Minus; with the following number subtracted.

messages.en: Are you okay? You've been yawning this whole time.
I didn't get enough sleep last night. I was up till three finishing some work, then had to get up early this morning too.
No wonder. Get some rest after you eat if you have time.

senses.en_definition: The twelfth letter of the Malay Roman alphabet, written l in lower case and L in upper case.
The symbol for litre, a unit of volume used especially for liquids.

messages.en: This bottle of water's only 2 litres, right? Will two bottles be enough for the four of us?
We'll probably be out till the evening. Let's get three bottles, just in case two aren't enough.
